title: Refit the Viru Gate chain and bell striker

approval.notes: Design contract for P4-002 playable cycle.

concrete_order: Forge tempered portcullis links and a reliable bell striker before the next Viru Gate alarm drill.
hidden_contradiction: Every link Kalev forges will return at St. George's Night: honest steel holds the gate, a hidden fracture breaks under strain, and a release pin opens the city to rebels.

investigation_clues.summary: The portcullis groove is pitted and the chain squeals during weekly tests.
Henning doubled east-wall patrols after the failed alarm test.
The bell striker drum shows stress cracks at Kalev's earlier fittings.
Rebel chalk marks map the gate rotation from the wall circuit.

forging_options.label: Forge true tempered links and a reliable striker.

effects.summary: Forged a reliable Viru Gate chain and striker for the watch.

forging_options.label: Hide a stress-fractured middle link that fails under ram pressure.

effects.summary: Concealed a stress fracture in the Viru Gate portcullis chain.

forging_options.label: Forge a concealed quick-release pin Mart can trigger from inside.

effects.summary: Forged a concealed quick-release pin in the Viru Gate chain assembly.

night_consequence: The forged chain assembly changes Viru Gate install routes, patrol pressure, and act-climax readiness during the curfew install beat.

source_notes.summary: Commission contract for The Bell and the Chain cycle.
